ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.title: Network status
ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.why: Lets the app check whether the phone is online.
ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.if_granted: The app can show an offline message.

INTERNET.title: Internet access
INTERNET.why: Lets pages load online content and call web services.

POST_NOTIFICATIONS.title: Show notifications
POST_NOTIFICATIONS.if_denied: No alerts are shown; the rest of the app works.
POST_NOTIFICATIONS.android: Runtime permission from Android 13 (API 33); older versions grant it automatically.

SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.title: Exact alarms
SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.why: Lets reminders fire at the exact minute.
SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.if_denied: Reminders still fire but may be a few minutes late.
SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.android: Android 12+ restricts it; Android 13+ does not grant it by default. Google Play limits its use to apps whose main job is alarms or calendars.

RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED.title: Run after restart
RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED.why: Lets the app restore reminders after the phone restarts.
RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED.if_denied: Reminders are lost when the phone restarts.

VIBRATE.title: Vibration
VIBRATE.why: Lets the app vibrate the phone.

USE_BIOMETRIC.title: Fingerprint or face unlock
USE_BIOMETRIC.why: Lets the app ask for fingerprint, face or screen lock.
USE_BIOMETRIC.android: PIN fallback together with biometrics needs Android 11 (API 30).

CAMERA.title: Camera
CAMERA.why: Needed to take photos or video.
CAMERA.if_denied: Photo capture does not work; the rest of the app does.

RECORD_AUDIO.title: Microphone
RECORD_AUDIO.why: Needed to record audio or speech.

ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.title: Location in the background
ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.why: Needed to read location while the app is closed.
ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.if_denied: Location only while the app is open.
ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.android: Separate request from Android 10; Google Play requires a declaration.

BLUETOOTH_SCAN.title: Find Bluetooth devices
BLUETOOTH_SCAN.why: Needed to discover nearby Bluetooth devices.

BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.title: Connect to Bluetooth devices
BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.why: Needed to connect to paired devices.

ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.title: Physical activity
ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.why: Needed for step counting and activity detection.
ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.if_granted: Step and activity data is available.

FOREGROUND_SERVICE.title: Foreground service
FOREGROUND_SERVICE.why: Lets long visible tasks keep running.
FOREGROUND_SERVICE.if_granted: Long tasks keep running with a notification.
FOREGROUND_SERVICE.android: Android 14 also needs a service type.

READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.title: Read shared storage
READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.why: Old way to read files (Android 12 and older).
READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.android: Replaced by media permissions on Android 13.

READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.title: Read audio files
READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.why: Needed to read audio files directly.

unsupported_web_apis.name: Service workers
unsupported_web_apis.why: Service workers do not run for app-internal files.
unsupported_web_apis.alternative: Use the notifications and reminders features instead.

unsupported_web_apis.name: WebUSB
unsupported_web_apis.why: Not available in the Android WebView.

unsupported_web_apis.name: Web Serial
unsupported_web_apis.why: Not available in the Android WebView.

unsupported_web_apis.name: Payment Request API
unsupported_web_apis.why: Not available in the Android WebView.
unsupported_web_apis.alternative: Use a hosted checkout page in the browser.

features.name: App shell (WebView)
features.summary: Runs your HTML inside the Android app.
features.does: Wraps your page in a native screen with back handling, loading bar, pull to refresh and offline message.
features.benefit: Your page runs as a normal app.

preview.note: The preview iframe shows the page.

features.name: Offline files
features.summary: Serves your files from inside the app so no internet is needed.
features.does: Serves files over a private https address built into the app.
features.benefit: Works offline and avoids unsafe file:// access.

features.name: Open outside links in the browser
features.summary: Links to other sites open in the phone browser, not inside your app.
features.does: Any link that is not part of your app opens in the browser.
features.benefit: Keeps remote websites away from the app and its native features.
features.security: Prevents remote pages from using the native bridge.

features.name: Notifications
features.summary: Shows alerts from your app.
features.does: Adds Android.notify(title, text) and a notification channel.
features.benefit: Alerts the user about things that matter.
features.cost: Asks the user for notification permission on Android 13+.
features.privacy: Notification text can show on the lock screen.

preview.note: A real notification cannot be shown in the preview.

test.how: Test button sends one notification on a real phone (inside the APK).

features.android: Channels from Android 8; runtime permission from Android 13.

features.name: Scheduled reminders
features.summary: Shows a notification at a chosen date and time, even when the app is closed.
features.does: Adds Android.schedule(id, timeMs, title, text) and Android.cancel(id) using the system alarm service, not a JavaScript timer.
features.benefit: Expiry alerts and reminders still work after the app is closed.
features.cost: Needs notifications; reminders are lost on restart unless boot recovery is on.
features.battery: Low: the system wakes the app only when a reminder is due.
features.storage: Stores a small list of pending reminders.
features.if_off: Android.schedule() does nothing and timers stop when the app closes.

test.how: Schedule a reminder one minute ahead, close the app, wait for the notification.

features.name: Restore reminders after restart
features.summary: Puts pending reminders back after the phone restarts.
features.does: Re-schedules saved reminders when the phone finishes starting.
features.if_off: Reminders set before a restart are lost.

test.how: Schedule a reminder, restart the phone, check that it still fires.

features.android: Android 15 limits some foreground-service starts at boot; this feature does not use one.

features.name: Exact-time reminders
features.summary: Makes reminders fire at the exact minute.
features.caution: Android restricts exact alarms and Google Play limits them to alarm and calendar style apps. Approximate timing is enough for most reminders.
features.does: Uses exact alarms when Android allows it, otherwise falls back to approximate timing.
features.cost: Special permission, Play policy review, more battery use.
features.if_off: Reminders use approximate timing and may be a few minutes late.

test.how: Schedule a reminder for the next minute and check the time it fires.

features.android: Android 12+ restricts it; Android 13+ does not grant it by default.

features.name: Vibration
features.summary: Vibrates the phone.

test.how: Test button vibrates for 200 ms on a real phone.

features.name: Short messages (toast)
features.summary: Shows a short pop-up message.

preview.note: The mock bridge shows the message in the preview.

test.how: Test button shows a toast on a real phone.

features.name: Share and copy
features.summary: Opens the Android share sheet and copies text.
features.benefit: Users can send content to other apps.
features.privacy: Content goes to the app the user picks.

preview.note: The share sheet is part of Android.

test.how: Test button opens the share sheet with sample text.

features.name: File picker
features.summary: Lets the user choose files from the phone.
features.does: Makes <input type=file> work by opening the Android file picker.
features.cost: Only files the user picks are readable.
features.privacy: The app sees only the chosen files.
features.if_off: File inputs in your page do nothing.

preview.note: Opens the browser picker in the preview.

features.name: Save files to Downloads
features.summary: Saves a file made by your page into the phone Downloads folder.
features.benefit: Exports and backups reach the Downloads folder.
features.cost: Browser-style download links do not work inside a WebView.
features.storage: Writes files the user can see.

test.how: Test button saves a small test.txt to Downloads.

features.android: Saved to the real Downloads folder on Android 10+. On Android 9 and older it is saved in the app folder.

features.name: Read text aloud
features.summary: Speaks text using the phone voice.
features.cost: Needs a voice installed on the phone.

preview.note: The browser can speak a sample sentence.

test.how: Test button speaks a sample sentence.

features.name: Network and version info
features.summary: Tells the page whether the phone is online and the app version.
features.benefit: Pages can adapt to offline use.

preview.note: The mock bridge reports a fixed value.

features.name: Fingerprint or PIN lock
features.summary: Asks for fingerprint, face or screen lock when the app opens.
features.does: Hides the app until the user unlocks it.
features.cost: If the phone has no lock set up, the app opens without one. On Android 10 and older there is no PIN fallback.
features.security: Protects the screen, not the stored data.

test.how: Reopen the app on a real phone.

features.android: PIN together with biometrics needs Android 11 (API 30).

features.name: Block screenshots
features.summary: Stops screenshots and hides the app in recent apps.
features.cost: Users cannot take screenshots of the app.

test.how: Try a screenshot on a real phone.

features.name: Fullscreen mode
features.summary: Hides the status and navigation bars.
features.does: Uses immersive mode; swipe from the edge shows the bars briefly.

preview.note: The display preview hides the bars.

test.how: Open the app on a real phone.

features.name: Screen animation
features.summary: Animates the app opening and closing.
features.does: Fade, slide or zoom when the app screen opens or closes, and a fade when pages load.

preview.note: The builder preview can play each style.

features.name: Background jobs (WorkManager)
features.summary: Runs deferrable work such as sync and cleanup.

features.name: Repeating reminders
features.summary: Daily, weekly or custom repeating reminders.

features.name: Push notifications (FCM)
features.summary: Messages sent from a server while the app is closed.
features.caution: Needs a backend server and a Firebase file for each app.

features.name: Foreground service
features.summary: Keeps a long visible task running.
features.caution: Android and Google Play restrict it; each service needs a declared type.

features.name: ZIP import and export
features.summary: Reads and writes ZIP projects safely.
features.caution: Needs path-traversal and size limits.

features.name: Background downloads and uploads
features.summary: Transfers files with progress and retry.

features.name: Camera
features.summary: Takes photos or video.
features.caution: Sensitive permission.

features.name: Photo picker
features.summary: Chooses photos without storage permission.

features.name: Microphone recording
features.summary: Records audio.
features.caution: Sensitive permission.

features.name: Speech to text
features.summary: Turns speech into text.
features.caution: Needs the microphone.

features.name: Background audio playback
features.summary: Keeps audio playing with the screen off.

features.name: Location (while open)
features.summary: Reads the phone location while the app is open.
features.caution: Sensitive permission and privacy impact.

features.name: Location (in the background)
features.summary: Reads location while the app is closed.
features.caution: Needs a Google Play declaration and uses more battery. Enable only if truly required.

features.name: Geofencing
features.summary: Alerts when the phone enters or leaves an area.

features.name: Maps
features.summary: Shows maps and routes.
features.caution: Google Maps needs an API key; OpenStreetMap in HTML needs none.

features.name: Bluetooth LE
features.summary: Talks to nearby Bluetooth devices.

features.name: NFC
features.summary: Reads NFC tags.

features.name: Device sensors
features.summary: Reads motion and other sensors.

features.name: Secure storage
features.summary: Stores tokens and secrets encrypted.

features.name: Deep links
features.summary: Opens the app from links.

features.name: Verified app links
features.summary: Opens the app from your own web links without a chooser.
features.caution: Needs a website you control (assetlinks.json).

features.name: Home-screen shortcuts
features.summary: Long-press shortcuts to app screens.

features.name: Home-screen widgets
features.summary: Small live panels on the home screen.

features.name: Local database (Room)
features.summary: Reliable structured storage for background work.

features.name: Backup and restore
features.summary: Exports and restores app data.

features.name: Cloud sync
features.summary: Keeps data in sync across devices.
features.caution: Needs a backend server.

features.name: Hosted database
features.summary: Stores app data on a server.
features.caution: Needs a backend and privacy disclosures.

features.name: Sign-in accounts
features.summary: Username or token based sign-in.
features.caution: Needs a server; tokens must use secure storage.

features.name: OAuth / social sign-in
features.summary: Sign in with an external provider.
features.caution: Needs provider setup and Custom Tabs.

features.name: Analytics
features.summary: Counts feature usage.
features.caution: Privacy and Play data-safety disclosure required; off by default.

features.name: Crash reporting
features.summary: Sends crash reports.
features.caution: Privacy and Play data-safety disclosure required; off by default.

features.name: Emulator testing
features.summary: Runs the app on test devices automatically.

features.name: Release APK
features.summary: Optimised, signed APK for direct installation.

features.name: Android App Bundle (AAB)
features.summary: Upload format for Google Play.

features.name: App signing and keystore
features.summary: Signs releases with your own key.
features.caution: Losing the key blocks future updates.

features.name: Google Play publishing
features.summary: Uploads builds to Google Play automatically.
features.caution: Needs a Play developer account and a service-account secret; uploads go to the internal test track first.

features.name: Plugin / extension system
features.summary: Adds new native capabilities as plugins.

features.name: Remote content updates
features.summary: Updates data or content without a new APK.
features.caution: Data only; downloading executable code is not allowed by Google Play.

features.name: Languages and right-to-left
features.summary: Multiple languages and RTL layouts.

features.name: Accessibility checks
features.summary: Checks labels, contrast and touch sizes.
